name: gdisc-monorepo
description: GDisC - Ultra-fast, lightweight real-time communication platform

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:client
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:client && npm run build --workspace=@gdisc/desktop && electron-builder --project apps/desktop
scripts.build:android: npm run build:client && node scripts/generate-android-icons.mjs && cd apps/mobile && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run build:android && cd apps/mobile/android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug --no-daemon && powershell -Command "if (!(Test-Path ../../../dist-android)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path ../../../dist-android | Out-Null }; Copy-Item -Path app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk -Destination ../../../dist-android/GDisC-1.0.1-debug.apk -Force"
scripts.open:android: cd apps/mobile && npx cap open android

author: GDisC Team
